title: The Market's Bounty
story:
James woke to the faint morning bell of Oakhaven chiming across the slate roofs, his stomach reminding him with a gentle, hollow ache that he had eaten little since leaving the Great Canopy. He adjusted the leather strap of his brass canister, checking that Elena's two metal coins and Barnaby's map were secure before descending the grand spiral staircase out of the library. Stepping back into the crisp, rain-washed air of the town, he followed the winding cobblestone lanes toward the heart of the bustling market square where the scent of roasting chestnuts and damp earth hung thick.

At the corner of a sunlit plaza, past stalls draped in canvas awnings, James spotted a cheerful vendor arranging bright mounds of wild blackberries and golden cape gooseberries on woven wicker trays. This woman, with a kind and weathered face, laughed as she tossed a copper weight onto her scale, her stall overflowing with the vivid colors of the local harvest. James crept closer, drawn by the sweet, enticing fragrance that seemed to chase away the lingering chill of the misty morning.

Reaching into his brass canister, James retrieved one of his newly earned metal coins and placed it carefully upon the rough wooden edge of the vendor's cart. The woman blinked in surprise down at the small monkey, offered a warm, understanding grin, and scooped a generous handful of dark, ripe berries into a folded square of paper. James accepted his prize with a quiet nod, tasting the burst of sweet juice that instantly satisfied the long hunger in his chest.

With his belly full and the morning sun finally breaking through the high gray clouds, James wandered deeper into the lively maze of Oakhaven, watching townsfolk bustle past with baskets of fresh bread and leafy greens. He paused beside a bubbling stone fountain at the center of the square, feeling the steady hum of the city wrap around him like an old coat. There was still so much of the world left to see, and every cobblestone alleyway seemed to whisper an invitation toward some new, uncharted horizon.
